summary: Get window.localStorage using the document origin/policy storage area.

target.notes: Resolve the origin-partitioned local storage area and return the Window's holder object; throw SecurityError when storage is unavailable by origin/policy.

caveats: Opaque origins and user policy can make the getter throw.

tests.name: opaque/policy-denied origin throws
tests.input: /* in an opaque or denied origin */ try{void window.localStorage}catch(e){console.log(e.name)}
tests.expected_behavior: prints SecurityError in the denied case
